722570101.text: There are two rows of text on this headstone. The first row is in the script of Byakuyakoku and is unintelligible.

722570102.text: The second row is in the common script, and it goes as follows:

722570103.text: "Here lies Ion no Mikoto, versed in fortune-telling and sigil-signs, but who often predicted falsely, never errant only when reading the span of his own years."
